name: General Presentation Delivery
description: Evaluates vocal clarity, fluency & hiccup control, pacing & pausing, vocal variety, and composure.

criteria.name: Vocal Clarity & Projection
criteria.description: Evaluates articulation, breath support, and consistent projection across the presentation.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Consistently clear articulation, strong breath support, and dynamic projection that fills the space effortlessly.
criteria.developing_anchor: Frequent mumbling, dropped endings, poor breath support, or weak projection that makes comprehension difficult.

criteria.name: Fluency & Hiccup Control
criteria.description: Measures verbal fluidity and minimization of fillers, false starts, and hesitation hiccups.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Seamless speech with negligible fillers (um, ah, like) and exceptionally smooth transitions between thoughts.
criteria.developing_anchor: Heavy reliance on verbal fillers, frequent false starts, repetitive loops, and noticeable hesitation hiccups.

criteria.name: Pacing & Strategic Pausing
criteria.description: Assesses speech rate appropriateness and the deliberate use of pauses for emphasis.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Well-calibrated speaking rate with purposeful, dramatic pauses that enhance audience comprehension and dramatic impact.
criteria.developing_anchor: Rushed cadence without breathing room, or excessively slow, choppy pacing that loses audience attention.

criteria.name: Vocal Variety & Engagement
criteria.description: Evaluates modulation of pitch, tone, and inflection to maintain audience engagement.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Expressive modulation of pitch and tone that vividly communicates emotion, enthusiasm, and key points.
criteria.developing_anchor: Monotone delivery lacking inflection, emotion, or dynamic contrast, leading to listener fatigue.

criteria.name: Structure & Composure
criteria.description: Measures organizational clarity and overall poise under delivery pressure.
criteria.exemplary_anchor: Immaculate logical structure with unshakable composure, confidence, and polished professional presence.
criteria.developing_anchor: Disjointed presentation flow with visible nervousness, nervous fidgeting, or flustered composure.
